source_title: NYSDOT 17 NYCRR Part 154 (Special Hauling Permits) + VTL §385 (legal limits) + NYSDOT Superloads page

superload_thresholds.note: Superload (NYSDOT superloads page) = exceeds 16' width, is 16' high or greater, exceeds 160' length, or is 200,000 lbs gross or greater (or a combination). Requires intensive review, additional documentation, and a bond submitted to the Department. Contact Permits@dot.ny.gov.

width.note: over 12' wide: 1 certified escort — precedes on 2-lane (other than 4-lane/divided), follows on 4-lane/divided (17 NYCRR §154-1.8(b))
mobile/modular units over 14' to 16' wide: 2 certified escorts (front + rear); 2 on all two-lane highways; police escorts may be substituted if more than 2 are required (§154-1.11(b))
over 16' wide = superload; escorts/police set case-by-case with a bond (NYSDOT superloads page)

height.note: 14' high or over: certified escort; every front escort carries a height-measuring device when escorting an overheight load (§154-1.12)

length.note: over 80' on other than 4-lane/divided highways: preceded by a certified escort; over 65' requires front and rear warning signs (§154-1.8(c))

single_trip.fee_formula: Trip permit (single or round trip) $40 at a Main Office / $60 at a Region Office, valid up to 5 permissible hauling days, one movement; amendment $10; plus $4 per trip if using the Departmental blanket insurance policy instead of a certificate on file (17 NYCRR §154-1.20). New York uses FLAT fees — there is NO per-mile or per-ton overweight charge.
single_trip.note: Divisible-load overweight caps are axle-group based per permit category (§154-2.4); nondivisible steering axle capped at 22,400 lbs. Special/sealed-container and radius permits carry their own fees.

annual.note: Divisible-load overweight annual permits $360-$1,000/yr by category (F1-F6, §154-2.11); agricultural 4-month fees roughly half. Nondivisible blanket/radius permits $60/mo (up to $360-$750/yr); Special Vehicle Combination annual $500; sealed shipping container annual $750.

movement_restrictions: Daylight only: movement not authorized from one-half hour after sunset to one-half hour before sunrise, unless the permit face states otherwise (17 NYCRR §154-1.2(a)).
No Saturday, Sunday or holiday moves (New Year's, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas) and none from 12:00 noon the working day preceding those holidays.
Saturday-until-noon exception: loads within 12' wide and 85' long that maintain traffic-flow speed may move until 12:00 noon Saturday (unless a holiday).
Overweight-only moves that are not overdimensional, within 125% of legal weight and able to maintain traffic-flow speed are not time/day restricted.

No travel when visibility under 1,000 ft or the road is hazardous from rain/snow/ice/fog/flood/wind. NOTE: NYC has separate permit authority over the state-highway system within the five boroughs (out of scope here); downstate divisible permits are not valid on state highways within NYC (§154-2.20, §154-2.2(k)).
notes: Legal height 13'6"; width baseline is 96" (8'0") under VTL §385(1) with 102" (8'6") allowed on qualifying/access highways (8.5 recorded here); semitrailer 48' base, up to 53' on designated access highways (53 recorded here); overall combination 65'; gross capped at 80,000 lbs via Federal Bridge Formula (VTL §385(10)).

Escort matrix, single-trip and annual fees from official 17 NYCRR Part 154 subparts (regulation vintage 1994-1996); superload definition from the current live NYSDOT superloads page; legal limits from VTL §385 — all fetched 2026-07-16. The NY State Certified Escort Manual is incorporated by reference and not posted online. State-level rules only (NYC metro out of scope).
